prompt: A clean, straight-on railway DISPATCH control-room track diagram for a single line between two stations, ALDER on the left and BIRCH on the right, drawn 360 km apart on one horizontal track. Train A leaves ALDER heading right at 09:00 travelling 72 km/h; Train B leaves BIRCH heading left at 09:30 travelling 108 km/h (the two departures are at DIFFERENT clock times, so they do NOT meet at the midpoint). Both keep constant speed. In a boxed readout panel titled 'COMPUTED MEETING', print the single clock TIME at which the two trains meet, as 'TIME  HH:MM' in 24-hour form, and on the next line the distance of the meeting point from ALDER as '<number> km from ALDER' to one decimal place. Work both out yourself from the distance, speeds and the two different departure times; do not print any other numbers in the readout box.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show railway dispatch control-room single-line track diagram with two trains closing at staggered departure times and a boxed COMPUTED MEETING readout? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_time: This is a railway dispatch track diagram. In the boxed 'COMPUTED MEETING' readout, a clock TIME is printed on the line beginning 'TIME'. Read ONLY the time actually printed in that box; do NOT do any sums or correct it yourself, just transcribe what is on the line. Answer as HH:MM (24-hour) only.
reference.q_dist: This is a railway dispatch track diagram. In the boxed 'COMPUTED MEETING' readout, a distance 'X.X km from ALDER' is printed. Read ONLY the number of kilometres actually printed in that box; do NOT do any sums or correct it, just transcribe the printed figure. Answer with just the number.
reference.q_form: Does this image show a railway track diagram with two stations at the ends of a horizontal line and a boxed readout panel labelled 'COMPUTED MEETING'? Answer yes or no only.

steps.read_number: Read the distance between stations ALDER and BIRCH labelled on the track diagram (in km). Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

Read Train A's speed labelled on the diagram (in km/h). Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

Read Train B's speed labelled on the diagram (in km/h). Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

steps.ask: Does the 'COMPUTED MEETING' readout box show the meeting time as 11:00 (the naive midpoint-meeting time ignoring the different departure times)? Answer yes or no only.
